mapper.sql: e.id AS id, e.rule_id AS ruleId, r.rule_code AS ruleCode, e.error_code AS errorCode, e.status AS status, e.recovery_status AS recoveryStatus, e.occurrence_count AS occurrenceCount, e.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, e.first_seen_at AS firstSeenAt, e.last_seen_at AS lastSeenAt, e.acknowledged_at AS acknowledgedAt, e.recovered_at AS recoveredAt, e.resolved_at AS resolvedAt, e.version AS version
FROM alert_events e JOIN alert_rules r ON r.id=e.rule_id AND r.tenant_id=e.tenant_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.tenant_id=#{tenantId}
